description: Show how a meta rule would change the pages it matches, before you add it with add_meta_rule. Pass a page URL to check one page. Changes nothing and spends no AI allowance. Needs a token; a read-only key is sufficient.

brand.description: Preview with this brand name instead of the saved one.

canonical.description: self points the canonical at the page. custom uses canonical_url.

canonical_url.description: The canonical URL. Required when canonical is custom.

domain.description: The connected domain, as a hostname, e.g. example.com.

mode.description: fill only writes where the page has no value. override replaces the page value. Defaults to fill.

pattern.description: The URL pattern the rule applies to, e.g. https://example.com/casino/*.

priority.description: Higher priority wins when several rules match. Defaults to 0.

url.description: Check this one page against the rule.

name: preview_meta_rule
title: Preview meta rule
